candidates.name: Idle backlight dimming
candidates.user_value: Reduces light and power while leaving the meter illuminated.
candidates.implementation_cost: Low; a small independent monotonic-time C policy drives existing GPIO6 LEDC.
candidates.risk: A low duty could make the values difficult to read.
candidates.verification_method: Host C boundary checks at 59,999 and 60,000 ms plus an operator readability check before and after idle.
candidates.selection_reason: Small, independently tested use of an existing board resource with no new device dependency.

candidates.name: QMI8658 orientation navigation
candidates.user_value: Keeps content upright when the device is physically turned.
candidates.implementation_cost: Medium/high; requires I2C startup, orientation filtering, debounce, coordinate remap, and return behavior.
candidates.risk: Sensor noise could unexpectedly rotate or clip the dashboard.
candidates.verification_method: Exercise each orientation, debounce, return, USB activity, and recovery after turning the board back.
candidates.selection_reason: The fixed landscape coordinates first need physical confirmation; sensor-driven rotation adds risk to the core display path.

candidates.name: PCF85063 time continuity
candidates.user_value: Could preserve a wall-clock reference across a board restart.
candidates.implementation_cost: Medium; requires RTC validity and backup-power checks plus a defined unknown-time fallback.
candidates.risk: Backup power is unconfirmed, so an invalid RTC could present stale data as current.
candidates.verification_method: Check RTC validity and backup retention; invalidate the input and confirm the display reports unknown time.
candidates.selection_reason: The required backup supply and RTC validity are unconfirmed, while the contract requires unknown time when the reference is uncertain.
